how to become the most
confident speaker in any room

1. pause before you answer

a two-second pause looks
thoughtful, never lost.

2. drop the "sorry, but"

start with your idea.
it already deserves the space.

3. use people's names

once, naturally. it makes
them feel truly heard.

4. ask one good follow-up

"what made you choose that?"
keeps any conversation alive.

5. breathe slowly before
you speak

one long breath calms
a shaky voice.

6. always have something
fresh to share

a story from history,
a painting, a strange fact.
